reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000972 (the melody read from 000972a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 22); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. B. B. Beall's dates (1874–1945) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Beall_BB (Beall, B. B. (Benjamin Burk); 'born on May 25, 1874, Dallas, Georgia ... died on October 7, 1945, in Douglasville, Georgia', from the Cyber Hymnal); https://hymnary.org/hymn/CCEH/972 links CCEH's SING TO ME OF HEAVEN (1914) to that page; https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no2010129566 (Beall, B. B. (Benjamin Burk), compiler of Joyful lays, no dates); CCEH's page gives only the year 1914. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000972a.nwc).
